title: Sandbox model card v0.1 (sandbox-model-card/0.1)
description: What the provider declares about the system under test (Annex IV, 2(b)), committed through the gate and written into the ledger. The required fields are histor/sandbox/modelcard.py REQUIRED; everything else is optional and open, because a card is a declaration the sandbox pins, not one it checks. For a hosted model the card is the pinned artefact: the plan's model_image_digest is the sha256 of its canonical JSON.

licence.description: As declared by the provider. The licence report recorded at commit_model (by the engine's licence tool) is what the sandbox observed of an image; this is what was stated.

output.description: Free text, or the response schema with its field names.
